name: Piloulder
look: a towering inukshuk of stones: stacked stone legs on a mossy slab, a body of tilted flat slabs under a broad slab of shoulders, a small grey head with stern eyes, and two tall standing stones floating beside it as arms
entry: It stands for years on high ridges, so still that it is mistaken for a stone marker. Lost travellers who follow the way its arms point always find their path home.
how: Wild: rare on mountains and highlands.
